description: Pilot 01 (2026-09-29): 30 scripted Spanish sentences mouthed silently by one speaker, read by the Ma et al. (2022) CMU-MOSEAS Spanish visual model, then corrected by an LLM given the conversational context. No video or landmarks are included.
